class.name: ClothInstance3D
class.brief_description: Mesh node that simulates and renders a [CgameXPBDCloth].
class.description: [ClothInstance3D] owns a [CgameXPBDCloth], steps it every physics frame (outside the editor) and keeps its [ArrayMesh] in sync. While the cloth topology is unchanged, vertex positions and normals are streamed to the GPU in place with [method RenderingServer.mesh_surface_update_vertex_region], so no mesh arrays are rebuilt. When tearing changes the triangle list, or the surface layout does not allow in-place updates, the mesh is rebuilt. The cloth runs in world space; the node converts positions to its local space for rendering, so the node can be moved without teleporting the cloth. Particles can be pinned to bones of a [Skeleton3D] with [method attach_particle_to_bone]. Pinned particles glide toward the current bone transform during each step. [codeblock] var cloth := CgameXPBDCloth.new() cloth.setup_grid(16, 24, 0.04, Transform3D(Basis(), Vector3(0, 1.6, 0))) var node := ClothInstance3D.new() add_child(node) node.set_cloth(cloth) node.cloth_skeleton_path = ^"../Skeleton3D" for i in range(cloth.columns()): node.attach_particle_to_bone(cloth.index_of(i, 0), "Spine2") [/codeblock]

method.name: attach_particle_to_bone
method.description: Pins cloth particle [param particle] to the bone named [param bone] of the skeleton at [member cloth_skeleton_path], at [param offset] in bone-local space. Does nothing and prints an error if no cloth is set or the index is out of range. Bones that cannot be found are skipped at runtime.

method.name: clear_bone_attachments
method.description: Removes all bone attachments and releases the attached particles.

method.name: detach_particle_from_bone
method.description: Removes the bone attachment of [param particle] and releases the particle.

method.name: get_bone_attachments
method.description: Returns the bone attachment map. Keys are particle indices; values are arrays [code][bone_name, offset][/code].

method.name: is_using_fast_update
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the mesh is currently refreshed in place through the rendering server instead of being rebuilt.

method.name: rebuild_mesh
method.description: Rebuilds the [ArrayMesh] from the current cloth state. This happens automatically when the cloth is assigned and when tearing changes the triangles.

method.name: set_bone_attachments
method.description: Replaces all bone attachments. Keys are particle indices; values are either a bone name or an array [code][bone_name, offset][/code].

method.name: set_cloth
method.description: Sets the cloth to simulate and render. The mesh is created immediately when the node is inside the scene tree, otherwise when it enters it.

method.name: simulate
method.description: Updates bone attachments, steps the cloth by [param delta] seconds using [member substeps] and refreshes the mesh. This is what the physics notification calls; it can also be used for manual stepping, for example in the editor or in tests.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the cloth is stepped every physics frame. The simulation never runs automatically in the editor.
Path to the [Skeleton3D] that provides the bone transforms for bone attachments.
Number of solver sub-steps per physics frame, from [code]1[/code] to [code]64[/code].
